name: Yufuin Onsen District

en.name: Yufuin Onsen District
en.description: Yufuin Onsen is one of Japan's most beloved hot spring towns, nestled at the base of Mount Yufu (Yufudake). Unlike Beppu's dramatic hells, Yufuin charms with its serene countryside atmosphere, upscale ryokan with open-air baths overlooking rice paddies, and a walkable main street lined with cafés and artisan shops.
highlights: Open-air rotenburo with Mount Yufu views
Lake Kinrin morning mist & café street

ja.name: 由布院温泉郷
ja.description: 由布院温泉は由布岳の麓に広がる全国有数の温泉地で、別府のような派手さはなく、田園風景に溶け込む露天風呂付きの高級旅館と洗練されたカフェや工芸品店が続く湯の坪街道が魅力です。湖畔の朝霧と合わせて、のんびりした湯治体験が楽しめます。
highlights: 由布岳を望む露天風呂付き旅館
湯の坪街道のカフェと工芸品店巡り
金鱗湖の朝霧と温泉情緒
